results.content: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across various natural language processing tasks. Serving LLM inference for generating long contents, however, poses a challenge due to the enormous memory footprint of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with the sequence length and batch size. In this paper, we present InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works [...] works with modern offloading-based inference systems. InfiniGen leverages the key insight that a few important tokens that are essential for computing the subsequent attention layer in the Transformer can be speculated by performing a minimal rehearsal with the inputs of the current layer and part of the query weight and key cache of the subsequent layer. This allows us to prefetch only the essential KV cache entries (without fetching them all), thereby mitigating the fetch overhead from the [...] InfiniGen predicts from the immediately preceding layer. For OPT-13B, measured on a random 2,000-token PG-19 sentence, the authors report an average cosine similarity of 0.96 between adjacent Transformer-block inputs across layers. The paper notes that inputs to distant layers differ.

results.content:
Generating long content with LLMs presents a challenge due to the substantial memory requirements of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with sequence length and batch size. This blog reviews InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework designed specifically for long-text generation, which integrates seamlessly with modern offloading-based inference systems, which leverage larger CPU memory. InfiniGen leverages a key insight: only a few essential tokens are [...] tokens are necessary to compute the attention layers of Transformers in subsequent steps. By speculating on these critical tokens using the inputs of the current layer and part of the query weight and key cache of the next layer, InfiniGen enables prefetching of only the essential KV cache entries, thus reducing fetch overhead from host CPU memory in offloading-based LLM systems.
